name: apple-mcp
description: Apple MCP server for Contacts, Messages, Notes, Reminders, and Calendar — a JXA fork with full CRUD, honest permission errors, per-app filtering, and no script injection.
author: Dhravya Shah and contributors

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && swiftc -O -framework EventKit -o dist/eventkit-helper helpers/EventKitHelper.swift
